PATIENTS WITH NEUTROPENIC FEVER WHOSE FEVER PERSISTS THROUGHOUT THE FIRST 3 TO 5

DAYS OF TREATMENT

If no infectious disease has been diagnosed but the patient is clinically

stable, continue the current regimen.  If vancomycin was part of initial therapy

but culture results have not yielded a pathogen that must be treated with

vancomycin, discontinue it to minimize development of resistance.

Consider adding amphotericin B for empirical antifungal therapy.  Hematology-

oncology or Infectious Diseases may recommend another antifungal like

micafungin or voriconazole.  Contact Infectious Diseases for more information.

If the patient is receiving prophylactic fluconazole, stop it when empirical

antifungals are started.

# Treatment

[Amphotericin B Liposomal 3-5MG/KG IV q24h \($$$$\)R,O+ NS Hydratio](orz-set-abx-amphotericin-liposomal-fluid-flush-orders)
